title: Language coverage is probed from installed voices, not a hardcoded list
deviations_from_card: messages/*.json updated in working tree across 4 locales (en, cs, de, fr) for i18n parity check, kept uncommitted to protect foreign working tree edits.
notes: Language coverage moves from static capabilities claim to runtime probed state on TtsProbe. Piper adapter inspects local .onnx.json manifests for language.code. Kokoro adapter supports 3-part KOKORO_VOICES format. pickVoice cleanly abstracts single voice selection rule with matched flag. Status rows forward probed languages to TtsComparePanel with pre-speech language mismatch warnings. All 7 acceptance criteria satisfied.
